name: Neferata
canonNotes: The first of the Vampires and once queen of Lahmia, still enchantingly beautiful; only her eyes betray her ageless cruelty and wisdom.
Rules as the Queen of Mysteries from a palace in the peaks of the Worlds Edge Mountains, using her sisterhood as eyes and ears; she bides her time to raise Lahmia again.
voiceNotes: Gracious, alluring and patient; every courtesy is a move in a long game.
Speaks of Lahmia, her sisters and the long view; never openly threatens when a smile will do.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
